# Local Player

Source: [4807](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/4807); edited 2024-11-26. Evidence: archived documentation.

Not independently verified in the current game. An article edit date is not a behavioral test date.

Exact pinned API: [Local Player](../../api/values/local-player.md).

<a id="wiki-4807-n1"></a>

- Local Player differs per client, is restricted to visual/HUD actions, and cannot be stored in variables.

<a id="wiki-4807-n2"></a>

- One global HUD using Local Player can display different player data to each viewer, reducing text count and server load.

<a id="wiki-4807-n3"></a>

- Local Player visual elements are documented as not showing correctly for spectators or replays.

Source limitations:

- Spectator/replay limitation is archived behavior and needs current verification if relied upon.
